newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Sales of 27,800 MT were 93 percent above the week earlier and 37 percent over the 4-week average. Turkey (15,500 MT, of which 10,500 MT was rough), Mexico (5,600 MT, of which 5,400 MT was rough), Honduras (3,600 MT, of which 400 MT was rough) were the primary buyers.

Exports of 33,900 MT were double the previous week, but 17 percent below the 4-week average. The major destination was Saudi Arabia (18,100 MT), with smaller quantities to the Netherlands (5,600 MT), Haiti (2,800 MT), Mexico (2,400 MT), and Canada (2,300 MT).
